mapper.sql: d.id document_id, d.number, d.creator_id, d.creation_key, d.approval_status, d.current_node, d.current_version, d.revision, s.name, s.tax_id, s.dedup_key, s.contact, s.phone, s.address, s.bank_name, s.account_name, s.bank_account, s.attachment_paths, s.remark, d.create_time, d.update_time, u.user_name create_by, u.user_name update_by
mapper.select: select from documents d join suppliers s on s.document_id = d.id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.creator_id where d.type = 'SUPPLIER' and d.deleted = '0' and (exists(select 1 from sys_user cu where cu.user_id=d.creator_id and cu.dept_id=#{params.supplyScopeDeptId} and cu.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from purchase_orders po join documents pod on pod.id=po.document_id join sys_user bu on bu.user_id=po.buyer_id where po.supplier_id=d.id and pod.deleted='0' and bu.dept_id=#{params.supplyScopeDeptId} and bu.del_flag='0')) and (d.creator_id=#{params.supplyScopeUserId} or exists (select 1 from purchase_orders po join documents pod on pod.id=po.document_id where po.supplier_id=d.id and po.buyer_id=#{params.supplyScopeUserId} and pod.deleted='0')) and s.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and s.tax_id like concat('%', #{taxId}, '%') and d.number like concat('%', #{number}, '%') and d.approval_status = #{approvalStatus} order by d.update_time desc

select count(1) from documents d join suppliers s on s.document_id = d.id where d.id = #{documentId} and d.type='SUPPLIER' and d.deleted='0'
and (d.creator_id=#{userId} or exists(select 1 from purchase_orders po join documents pod on pod.id=po.document_id where po.supplier_id=d.id and po.buyer_id=#{userId} and pod.deleted='0')) and (exists(select 1 from sys_user cu where cu.user_id=d.creator_id and cu.dept_id=#{deptId} and cu.del_flag='0') or exists(select 1 from purchase_orders po join documents pod on pod.id=po.document_id join sys_user bu on bu.user_id=po.buyer_id where po.supplier_id=d.id and pod.deleted='0' and bu.dept_id=#{deptId} and bu.del_flag='0'))
select from documents d join suppliers s on s.document_id = d.id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = d.creator_id where d.id = #{documentId} and d.type = 'SUPPLIER' and d.deleted = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into documents (id, type, number, creator_id, creation_key, approval_status, current_version, revision, deleted, create_time, update_time) values (#{documentId}, 'SUPPLIER', #{number}, #{creatorId}, #{creationKey}, #{approvalStatus}, #{currentVersion}, #{revision}, '0', #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

insert into suppliers (document_id, name, tax_id, dedup_key, contact, phone, address, bank_name, account_name, bank_account, attachment_paths, remark) values (#{documentId}, #{name}, #{taxId}, #{dedupKey}, #{contact}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{bankName}, #{accountName}, #{bankAccount}, #{attachmentPaths}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update suppliers s join documents d on d.id = s.document_id set s.name = #{name}, s.tax_id = #{taxId}, s.dedup_key = #{dedupKey}, s.contact = #{contact}, s.phone = #{phone}, s.address = #{address}, s.bank_name = #{bankName}, s.account_name = #{accountName}, s.bank_account = #{bankAccount}, s.attachment_paths = #{attachmentPaths}, s.remark = #{remark}, d.revision = d.revision + 1, d.update_time = #{updateTime} where s.document_id = #{documentId} and d.revision = #{revision} and d.approval_status in ('DRAFT', 'RETURNED') and d.deleted = '0'
mapper.insert: insert ignore into number_sequences (document_type, business_date, next_value) values (#{type}, #{businessDate}, 1)
mapper.update: update number_sequences set next_value = next_value + 1 where document_type = #{type} and business_date = #{businessDate}
mapper.select: select next_value from number_sequences where document_type = #{type} and business_date = #{businessDate}
select id, flow_type, version, supervisor_candidates, finance_candidates from workflow_configs where flow_type = #{flowType} order by version desc limit 1

select count(1) from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{userId} and u.user_id<>#{excludeId} and u.status='0' and r.status='0' and r.role_key in('supervisor','purchasing_supervisor','purchase_supervisor')
select count(1) from document_attachments where document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.insert: insert into document_versions (id, document_id, version_no, snapshot_json, content_hash, submitted_by, submitted_at) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{snapshotJson}, #{contentHash}, #{submittedBy}, #{submittedAt})

insert into version_attachments(version_id,file_id,name_snapshot,sha256) select #{versionId},f.id,f.original_name,f.sha256 from document_attachments a join attachment_files f on f.id=a.file_id where a.document_id=#{documentId}
insert into workflow_instances (id, document_id, version_id, config_version, status, started_at) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{configVersion}, 'RUNNING', #{startedAt})
insert into workflow_tasks (id, instance_id, node, sequence_no, assignee_id, status) values (#{id}, #{instanceId}, 'SUPERVISOR', 1, #{assigneeId}, 'PENDING')

insert into audit_events (id, document_id, version_id, actor_id, actor_snapshot, action, reason, changes_json, created_at) values (#{id}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{actorId}, #{actorSnapshot}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{changesJson}, #{createdAt})
